question: What supreme attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment can arise for a practitioner
Being dear to yoginis is a possible outcome
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis
plain_english: He may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginis.
